name: Creative Media and Game Technologies
summary: A games degree split into programming, game design, visual arts and business and production tracks, with a portfolio assignment specific to whichever you choose. BUas caps it at about 200 students a year and runs four portfolio rounds from November to May, so applying early genuinely helps.

notes: A full IB Diploma is compared by Nuffic to a vwo diploma, and BUas offers a three-year track to applicants whose diploma is comparable to vwo. The standard hbo bachelor recorded on this programme is four years and 240 ECTS; the length of the short track was not established here, so it is not recorded as a credential.
